headline: Committee approves revised bus ad bill, defers Climate Action and Resiliency Revolving Fund bill

meeting.body: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to amend by replacing Bill 13 (2026) with Bill 13, CD1 (2026)
meeting.summary: The committee voted 6–0 to replace Bill 13 (2026) with a CD1 version on County bus ads. Bill 66 (2026), proposing a climate fund starting at 20 percent of TAT revenue, was deferred; the chair said it will probably return in the next few meetings.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Bill 13 (2026), which updates rules for ads on County buses and bus passes.[[0:04:09]] The transportation director said outside groups could only buy ads that offer to sell something.[[0:10:28]] The committee voted 6–0 to replace the bill with a revised version called CD1.[[0:42:20]] The committee chair presented Bill 66 (2026), which would create a Climate Action and Resiliency Revolving Fund.[[0:45:00]] The committee chair said the fund would start at 20 percent of TAT revenue.[[1:00:26]] The budget director said a fund set by ordinance would raise fewer concerns for rating agencies than one in the County charter.[[1:39:06]] The committee chair said Bill 66 will probably come back in the next few meetings.[[1:56:48]] The committee deferred the climate change item.[[1:56:53]]
decided: The committee approved replacing Bill 13 (2026) with the revised CD1 version.
meeting.next: After the law changes, the transportation department will put out a request for proposals from advertising agencies. The transportation director said the department may come back to change ad rates if proposals suggest different prices.
